status_vocabulary.confirmed_repository_description: Meaning is stated by the repository record or related publication.
status_vocabulary.confirmed_source_document: Meaning or coding is stated in a source document distributed with the dataset.
status_vocabulary.confirmed_column_header: The full survey item is present as the column header.
status_vocabulary.derived_and_empirically_verified: The formula was verified against every row in the deposited file.
status_vocabulary.partially_verified_rounding_unresolved: The construct is known, but deposited rounding does not reproduce exactly from visible components.
status_vocabulary.coding_not_deposited: The construct is known but the code-to-label mapping is absent from the local deposit.
status_vocabulary.needs_author_confirmation: The repository package does not support a more specific definition.

Nationality.description: Participant nationality; constant Saudi in the deposited analytic file.

Region.description: Saudi administrative region grouped as western, southern, eastern, northern, or central.

Family income per month.description: Monthly household income band in Saudi riyals.

Hight/cm.description: Self-reported height; source column retains the misspelling 'Hight'.

BMI.description: Body mass index computed as weight in kilograms divided by squared height in metres.

Do you have chronic diseases?.description: Reported physician-diagnosed chronic-disease category or combination.

Depression score.description: Sum of the 21 Beck Depression Inventory-II item scores; higher values represent more severe symptoms.

patterns.description_template: Beck Depression Inventory-II response score for item {1}; item wording is not reproduced in the repository workbook.

Timestamp.description: Survey submission timestamp. Treated conservatively as a direct/operational identifier because it is record-unique.

Researcher's number.description: Operational researcher or collector code. Treated conservatively as an identifier-like field despite low cardinality.

monthly income.description: Monthly income band in Saudi riyals.

City.description: Reported city category. Several English labels and spreadsheet-error tokens require depositor confirmation before substantive analysis.

Any comments, suggestions, or weight los.description: Optional free-text comment on weight-loss experience. Values must never be quoted or redistributed by this project.

Gender.description: Coded participant gender; code-to-label mapping is not present in the local workbook.

Nationality.description: Coded nationality category; code-to-label mapping is not present in the local workbook.

Education_Level.description: Coded latest educational qualification; code-to-label mapping is not present in the local workbook.

City.description: Coded Saudi city of residence; code-to-label mapping is not present in the local workbook.

P2_T.description: Total depression-instrument score across P2_1 to P2_20 as deposited; the sum is verified, but the related publication describes BDI-II and the workbook contains only 20 visible P2 item columns, which requires author confirmation.

P3_T.description: Total state-anxiety score across the 20 P3 items.

Age_Group.description: Three-level derived age group (young, middle-aged, old); numeric code-to-label mapping is not deposited locally.

Gain_LS.description: Mean affect rating for gain-framed, less-severe messages across desirable and undesirable outcomes.

Loss_LS.description: Mean affect rating for loss-framed, less-severe messages across desirable and undesirable outcomes.

Gain_MS.description: Mean affect rating for gain-framed, more-severe messages across desirable and undesirable outcomes.

Loss_MS.description: Mean affect rating for loss-framed, more-severe messages across desirable and undesirable outcomes.

Gain.description: Overall gain-frame affect score. Construct is confirmed, but the deposited rounding differs by up to 0.05 from the visible four-component mean.
Gain.formula: mean(P4LS_GD, P4LS_GUD, P4MS_GD, P4MS_GUD), deposited rounding

Loss.description: Overall loss-frame affect score. Construct is confirmed, but the deposited rounding differs by up to 0.05 from the visible four-component mean.
Loss.formula: mean(P4LS_LD, P4LS_LUD, P4MS_LD, P4MS_LUD), deposited rounding

Gain_D.description: Mean gain-frame affect rating for desirable outcomes across severity levels.

Gain_UD.description: Mean gain-frame affect rating for undesirable outcomes across severity levels.

Loss_D.description: Mean loss-frame affect rating for desirable outcomes across severity levels.

Loss_UD.description: Mean loss-frame affect rating for undesirable outcomes across severity levels.

patterns.description_template: Deposited depression-instrument item score P2 item {1}; exact item-to-question mapping is not included in the local deposit.
State Anxiety Inventory item {1} response score.
Mean affect rating for {2}-framed, {1}-severity messages with {3} outcomes (LS=less severe, MS=more severe, G=gain, L=loss, D=desirable, UD=undesirable).

Attrition.description: Whether the respondent had left a previous organization before the current job.

Years_Experience.description: Total years of work experience across all organizations.

Years_experience_lastorganization.description: Years of experience in the last organization the respondent left.

Sector.description: Sector of the last organization the respondent left.

Department.description: Department in the last organization the respondent left.

JobTitle.description: Job title held in the last organization the respondent left.

Allowances.description: Deposited coded representation of allowance type(s); local key describes allowance categories but the single numeric code requires depositor confirmation.

MedicalInsurance.description: Whether the last organization provided medical insurance.

Bonus.description: Whether an annual performance-related bonus was received.

OverTime.description: Whether overtime outside the standard schedule was worked.

Payment_Overtime.description: Whether overtime was paid, including the not-applicable category for no overtime.

Rewards&Wages_Satisfaction.description: Satisfaction with monthly income relative to effort, rewards, and wages.

Get_ Deserved_Promotion.description: Whether the respondent believed deserved promotion was received.

Training_programs_ During_last_three_yea.description: Number band of training programs provided during the last three years.

Useful_Training_Programs.description: Whether the respondent benefited from the training provided.

Business_Travel.description: Frequency of overnight or non-routine business travel.

Job_Support.description: Perceived organizational support for completing work.

Recognition.description: Whether supervisors provided moral appreciation and recognition.

Emotional_Commitment.description: Rated emotional commitment and psychological relationship with the organization.

Job_Engagement.description: Ease of involvement in the job, including participation in decisions and opinions.

Work_Live_Balance.description: Ease of balancing work and personal life; source retains the variable spelling 'Live'.

Physical_Stress.description: Frequency of physical stress caused by physically demanding workplace tasks.

Psychological_Exhaustion.description: Frequency of psychological exhaustion or mental/emotional fatigue from job stress.

Job_Stability.description: Whether the respondent felt job security and stability.

Health_Issues.description: Whether health problems contributed to leaving work.

Environment_Satisfaction.description: Satisfaction with the work environment, including colleagues, facilities, lighting, air conditioning, and noise.

Job_Satisfaction.description: Overall job satisfaction in the last organization.

Job_Opportunities.description: Whether alternative job opportunities were available while working in the last organization.

Income.description: Monthly household income band in Saudi riyals.

Employment sector.description: Employment sector(s) of the respondent; multi-select field.

SectorWorkplace transition likelihood.description: Self-reported likelihood of transitioning to a different employment sector after the driving reform.
SectorWorkplace transition likelihood.coding: 0 = unlikely; 1 = somewhat likely; 2 = likely; No = not applicable

Driving Licence.description: Whether the respondent obtained a driving licence after the reform.
